items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: An English lady named Dolores Gibbons was shot through the right shoulder, and the right lung.

ctx.x: Did Mike get there any of them? No. You were the only one that got hit then.
The only one, the only American. Yeah. An English lady named Dolores Gibbons was shot through the right shoulder, and the right lung.
Oh, it must have been serious. It was, it was.
